description: A skill claimed by the user. Can be endorsed by other users via id.sifa.endorsement.

main.description: Record representing a single professional skill.

subCategory.description: Optional user-defined grouping label nested under category (e.g., 'Frontend', 'Backend', 'Databases'). Freeform: unlike category there are no known values, so renderers can present skills in the user's own groups. Renderers decide the display label.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
